sources.label: Official Reformation Size Guide: Numeric measurements (regular, cm) and Numeric size conversion

audit: Old URL /pages/size-guide and /size-guide 404; the site's 'size guide' link goes to /fitting-and-sizes.html. Numeric measurements, regular, cm tab (bust/waist/hip; inch tab agrees within rounding), US 0-24; UK and EU/DE from the Numeric size conversion table on the same page (EU skips 50: US 20 = EU 52, as printed). Labels changed from letters to US numeric. The Alpha chart prints different values (e.g. M = 6/8: 37/29/40 in) so it was not merged and no altLabel is stored; petite and denim charts not stored. Old M (UK 10-12) 90/70/95 -> US 6 (UK 10) 91.5/71/99, US 8 (UK 12) 95/75/103; old XL (UK 14-16) 102/82/107 -> US 10 (UK 14) 100/80/108, US 12 (UK 16) 105.5/85/113. Extended sizes to US 24 (UK 28) added.
